title: Google owner Alphabet loses $500bn in market value after profit disappoints Wall Street
paragraphs: Shares in the Google parent Alphabet fell double digits Wednesday evening into Thursday trading, erasing hundreds of billions of dollars in stock market value from the $4tn tech giant.
The company had reported lower-than-expected profit and a slowdown in its advertising business while it maintained big spending on AI.
Net profit slid 25% from a year earlier to $26.2bn in the July-to-September period, or $2.12 a share, well short of expectations by analysts surveyed by FactSet.
